name: 重采样检测
description: 检测 interpolation 伪影 from image scaling, rotation, or skewing operations.
algorithm: Periodic Correlation Detection in Resampled Signals
mechanism: 分析 periodic 相关性s introduced by resampling operations. When an image is scaled or rotated, interpolation creates detectable periodic 模式 in pixel derivatives that can be revealed through 频谱分析.
parameters: Analysis: EM algorithm, Radon transform projection, Derivative filter: [-1, 1], Spectrum: 64-point DFT
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP
useCase: Detecting geometric transformations applied during image 拼接 or composition

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP

strengths:
• 对检测缩放/旋转高度准确
• 理论基础扎实
• 可估算重采样因子
• 适用于不同的插值方法
limitations:
• Requires large homogeneous regions
• May fail on heavily textured areas
• 计算密集 EM fitting
• JPEG压缩 can mask traces
